decisions.reason: As a sewer-related product for utilities and public buyers, it fits the firm's metal fabrication and fluid-handling customer base, and after only one year the option value of waiting is still high.

Public waste bins are somewhat adjacent to the firm's public-sector sales channels but are more standard and price-sensitive, so the firm would likely keep them for now while testing demand at low continuation cost.
Ground sleeves for posts are a simple, low-cost extension of standard metal fabrication, so management would likely leave this option open because market potential is not yet fully revealed.

Cast iron ground sleeves fit the firm's capabilities less well than its steel-based products and overlap with other sleeve offerings, so this is the most likely variant to be abandoned and resources redirected.
Steel ground sleeves align closely with the firm's steel-processing expertise and can be kept on the market cheaply while the firm learns whether they gain traction.
